scope: native 2D real images; exploratory, 7 layout seeds, no independent 3D data
input_data: scikit-image example imagery; native RGB; patch size 24, 8 sensors per R,G,B
estimand: RMSE of equal-weight within-role sparse sample mean to full-image weighted RGB mean; luma proxy WT=(.2126,.7152,.0722)
limitations: Images are not physical multisensor fields; do not infer performance on air quality or 3D microscopy
The heldout scenes are only two scene-level units; patches overlap and are not independent external replicates
COSI uses train covariance; compare with POWER-DIAG and DIRECT-EMPIRICAL, not only MHU
Selection/adaptation to these results is exploratory and cannot be promoted to blinded confirmation
Mismatched generation/runtime across techniques are explicitly reported
